decision.question: Where does the dev server's /api/folder-names and /api/index go?
options: leave and let the proxy forward only unmatched /api paths
decision.why: /dev/* is short and not under /api; a prefix that forwards some /api paths to one process and some to another is a special case the generic prefix list should not need

decision.question: Where does the per-project routes config live?
decision.why: the project owns its routes and start command; Servex has no monorepo special case; a central file would be a second list to keep in step

decision.question: How is monorepo-api started on demand?
options: a second Servex Project (monorepo-api) with a launch command, same Process/autostart/Starting-page path
decision.why: one of everything: stop_server, logs, adopt-after-restart and the Starting page all work with no new code path; the proxy only maps a path to a name

findings.text: `Servex/Servex.js:436` does not parse: `route.prefix.replace(//$/, "")` has lost its backslash, so `//` starts a comment and `node --check Servex/Servex.js` fails with "SyntaxError: Unexpected token '}'" at line 437. Merged as it is, Servex would not start again at the next restart (no dashboard, no proxy, no agents). It should read `replace(/\/$/, "")`. `ReverseProxy.test.mjs` never imports Servex.js, so its pass did not catch this.

Ask 2's checks through `http://monorepo.localhost` have not been run yet. task.jsonl says the Worker was tested on a private port (8791) with a forged Host header, and its `now` line is "review, merge, verify next". Still to do through the real proxy: dev login, `/app/`, `live.test.mjs`, and the dev server's own features (live reload, rpc writes, folder names, page index). That needs a Servex restart once fix 1 is in.

Ask 5 (send voice-app 3–5 short lines) has not been done: the task folder has no record of it. The oversized files to report are `youtube/*/meta.ndjson` (34 MB) and `framework/ai/tasks/state.jsonl` (27 MB). The owner's one job is adding the Google origins, `staging.lew42.com` and `lew42.com`.

`public/app/readme.md:5` still says to open the app with `node dev.mjs` then `http://localhost:8787/app/`. The normal local address is now `http://monorepo.localhost/app/`; keep :8787 only as the run without Servex, as `worker/readme.md` already does.

`public/framework/ai/cards/card.js:680` fetches a bare `/api/objects`, which Servex's dashboard serves (`Servex.js:988`). On `monorepo.localhost` that path now goes to the Worker. It used to get the dev server's 404; now it gets the Worker's 404, and the first such call also starts wrangler on demand. It should use `servex_url("/api/objects")`. The fallbacks `get_json("/api/agents")` (`AISession/AISessionsPage.js:536`) and `Role.js:33` act the same way, but they only run when Servex is down, and then so is the proxy.

The proxy's `wait` is 15 s, but wrangler's first boot took about 17 s (task.jsonl, 18:50). So the first `fetch` from `/app/` (`/api/config`, `/api/me`) will usually get a 503. That is documented, but it is worth checking during fix 2 that `/app/` retries or recovers rather than showing an error.

`worker/index.js:529`: `is_local` now accepts any `*.localhost`, and `dev.js` uses it to gate the dev login. This is safe as long as `API_HOSTS` and DEV_LOGIN stay local-only, as they are in `wrangler.jsonc`. A one-line comment in `dev.js` that the gate now covers every `.localhost` project name would help a future reader.

The design is the simple one: a second `Project` per route, configured in the project's own `package.json`, with `ReverseProxy.name()` mapping a path to a name. Ports, autostart, the Starting page, `stop_server` and logs all reuse existing code, and there is nothing special-cased for the monorepo. The `.assetsignore` claim checks out: no ignored path is in git except `framework/ai/whisper/files.jsonl`, which is re-included.
